Bill.BriefDescription: Providing medicaid coverage for youth temporarily placed in juvenile detention.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to medicaid coverage for youth temporarily placedin juvenile detention; adding a new section to chapter 74.09 RCW; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that youth temporarilydetained in county detention facilities are often in need of medical ormental health services. The legislature intends to use an opportunityin federal law to provide medicaid funded services for medicaideligible youth temporarily detained in these facilities.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In determining payment for services under medicaid, Title XIX ofthe federal social security act, the department shall interpret 42C.F.R. 435.1008 and 42 C.F.R. 435.1009 to allow payment for services onbehalf of a medicaid enrolled youth who is temporarily placed in ajuvenile detention facility. Temporary placement shall be defined as p. 1 HB 1387until adjudication or up to sixty continuous days, whichever occursfirst.
